disclaimer: Fictional test data. Every company, domain, host, certificate, IP and person is invented. IPs use the RFC 5737 documentation ranges, AS numbers use the RFC 5398 private range, domains use RFC 2606 reserved TLDs.
methodology: Passive reconnaissance only: public registry, corporate site, WHOIS, DNS, certificate transparency. No active scanning. This file carries no edges array on purpose, so the importer has to rebuild the structure from the reference fields and the case target.
